WHEN TO AVOID RPCI SET-UP?

(1) When you lots of volatility around breakout area.

(2) Short-term breadth is getting weak as less than 45% stocks are above 10 MA.

(3) RPCI setup appeared 30% above 50 EMA, so it’s now stretched.

(4) Big red volume bars crossing 50 days average line

(5) Don't trade RPCI set-ups in 5% circuit stocks

(6) Don't trade RPCI stocks placed in LT ASM.
